dedupe_keys.name: fire rover monthly waste and recycling facility fire reports us and canada since 2016

description: This series of monthly reports counts publicly reported fires at waste and recycling facilities in the United States and Canada. It is written by Ryan Fogelman, a fire protection executive at Fire Rover, a company selling fire detection and suppression systems, and is published on the company's resource centre and in the trade magazine Waste360. Each report gives the number of incidents in the month, their split by facility type, such as metal recycling yards, waste, paper and plastics facilities, organics, rubber, hazmat and electronics, and comparisons with the monthly averages since 2016; for example, May 2026 had 40 incidents against a 2016 to 2025 May average of 34. Coverage is North America, monthly from 2016, compiled from news and other public reports. Reports are free to read online as articles with charts; the author reserves all rights and the charts carry a no use without permission notice, and the underlying incident list is not published. Caveats: only publicly reported fires are counted, so totals are a lower bound, and the producer sells fire safety products. Simulation uses: incident frequencies by facility type for waste facility fire risk and service disruption models. Related records: the EPA lithium-ion battery fire analysis (data-epa-lithium-ion-battery-fires-waste-management) documents a key cause in more depth.
